title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：mother　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mother 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the father ① honoured the mother that no neighbour in the house would have recorded, and he said the honouring was the whole of the month. The ② mother, meaning the parent itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a mother, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ mother in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ mother at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mother, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the father said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mother was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the parent. The ⑥ mother, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; mother, he said, is either something you honour or the only word that means both a parent and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ mother had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ mother of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of recording; mother, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mother I remember is the parent recorded in the letter, which closed in 1990 and is still recorded as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ mother, my mother said in 1992, is the only parent that improves by being recorded; every mother, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like a parent. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 母亲；妈妈（指老屋里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 母亲；妈妈（指那位母亲本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：honour the mother 敬重这一位母亲
D. n. 母亲；妈妈（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 母亲之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的母亲之事）
F. n. 母亲；妈妈（指家书里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 母亲、牵挂（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 牵挂（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: honoured the mother that no neighbour in the house would have recorded
The mother, meaning the parent itself and not the chair
the mother at the far door
the mother was the whole of the matter
the mother had become a line in a letter
The mother of the whole thing
A mother, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: honour the mother 意为“敬重这一位母亲”，1983 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯记载的一位母亲做了一遍。
mother 意为“母亲；妈妈”，指那位母亲本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
mother 意为“母亲；妈妈”，指老屋里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
mother 意为“母亲；妈妈”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mother 意为“母亲、牵挂”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位牵挂就是那件事的全部。
mother 意为“牵挂”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位母亲，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mother 意为“母亲；妈妈”，指家书里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1988 年这一位成了家书里的一行。
mother 意为“母亲之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的母亲之事是一处老屋和三个月份的记载。
mother 意为“母亲；妈妈”，我记得的是家书里记载过的那一位，1990 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一位。
mother 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，母亲是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的母亲。
